build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked -p lorectl

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

capabilities.description: Lets toolbar areas marked data-tauri-drag-region move the window.

bundle.shortDescription: A local, private archive of your Claude Code and Codex sessions
bundle.longDescription: Lore keeps a local archive of your Claude Code and Codex sessions, linked to the git repositories they worked in. Search and read them in the app. Everything stays on your machine.
